results.content: Dr. Yadollahi holds a Canada Research Chair-Tier 2 in Cardio-Respiratory Engineering, is a Senior Scientist at the University Health Network's KITE research institute (UHN-KITE), an Associate Professor at the University of Toronto's Institute of Biomedical Engineering, and an adjunct faculty at the University of Manitoba. Her previous experiences include Deep Learning Inference at Intel and research in Neuro-science inspired AI at the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab. Having been awarded the Google Deep Mind fellowship and Vector Scholarship in AI during her MSc and BSc at the University of Toronto, Lana has led several initiatives to better the experience of fellow women in computer science and taught programming workshops to students from various disciplines. Dr. Atena Roshan Fekr is an Assistant Professor at the Institute of Biomedical Engineering (BME) and the Rehabilitation Sciences Institute (RSI), University of Toronto, and an Affiliate Scientist at the KITE Research Institute, Toronto Rehabilitation Institute, University Health Network (UHN).
